metrics.action: Convert a {gap} or {single-polarity} annotation into a test pair. Not-applicable needs no test.
metrics.detail: 42.6% carry both polarities. Of the remaining 1707: 840 not-applicable (ze deliberately does not do it, so no test is owed), 503 known gap (unimplemented, genuinely untested), and 364 single-polarity -- those DO have a passing tagged test, just one side of the pair, and the RFC gate fails if that test is missing. Only the gap column is untested work.
metrics.label: RFC MUST requirements proven by a positive+negative test pair

metrics.action: Replace a sleep with a payload-predicate wait (wait_until, dispatch_until), then lower the floor in the same change.
metrics.detail: A sleep is a guess about timing that hides the race it was added to mask. The ratchet allows the count to fall, never rise.
metrics.label: time.sleep() calls in .ci tests

metrics.action: Take the lowest-ranked subsystem and add malformed-input or fault-injection cases.
metrics.detail: Counts files using an error-expectation token (wantErr, ErrorIs, assert.Error, ...), with comments stripped. Setup guards of the form `if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }` are deliberately NOT counted: those assert the happy path. Blind spot: expecting *an* error is weaker than pinning the right one.
